items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: Mr. Simmons' son came here. He's a writer and...

ctx.x: This is my home, but I don't remember.

He was on the corner of Union. He was on the corner of Union and... Oh, Miss Cora. Huh? What is that... You know where that colored boy is working for him now? His son came here and... And... We'll talk... Where? For who? The potato chip. You know, that colored boy was driving... Mr. Simmons. Mr. Simmons' son came here. He's a writer and... Oh... You know Mr. Simmons? Mr. Simmons. Yes. Mr. Simmons. Yes. That's right. He was here. And he and I sit out there and we talk... I guess about two, three hours out there.…
Did you ever make any records yourself?
